data.name: Wolfsschanze – Operation Götterdämmerung
data.detailed_description:
Strike at the heart of the Nazi regime


East Prussia, 1944. Behind concrete, barbed wire and heavily armed security cordons lies one of the most dangerous places of the Second World War: the Wolf’s Lair – the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership.

As an elite soldier, you fight your way through tightly secured facilities, defensive positions and bunkers. Every advance is brutal, direct and fast-paced. Short, fierce gunfights await you, where every explosion blasts open the way and every hit brings you closer to the key figures of the dictatorship – all the way to the final showdown with Hitler himself.

  • Experience compact missions with intense firefights and uncompromising action.

  • Use a deadly arsenal of weapons, explosives, vehicles and heavy guns.

  • Take high-ranking officers and generals in your sights – up to and including Hitler.

  • Immerse yourself in the period with historical uniforms, flags and symbols.

  • Storm the Wolf's Lair – faithfully reconstructed using original blueprints and up-to-date satellite imagery.

data.short_description: In this uncompromising first-person shooter, storm the Wolf’s Lair in 1944, the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. Fight your way through bunkers, defensive positions and Nazi troops using weapons, explosives and vehicles, and eliminate officers all the way up to Hitler himself.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: CPU requirements are indicative only and may vary due to dynamically generated missions and AI behavior, which can significantly increase load depending on player actions.

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 / RTX 5060
  • DirectX: Version 12
